discovery_notes: First pass of lic-other 2016; 30 standard search-snippet queries, no prior lic/2016 keys existed. Found: Marvel SDCC 2016 Skottie Young series (28 pins; 2-packs, GWP singles, blind boxes - pack and blind members held), Marvel NYCC 2016 (set only), Monogram SDCC Kingdom Hearts sword pin bundle, Star Wars Celebration Europe emoji pins (two Road sets + ThinkGeek Jabba), ThinkGeek SDCC GWP pins (Rey speeder, BB-8), Loungefly SDCC Rey backpack pin (Loungefly-credited 2016 pin), Acme Spring Gathering super jumbos and HotArt Leia/Han. No dated 2016 Hot Topic, Her Universe, Funko, EE or ArtLand pins found.
